sentences.text: The genus name Ramphastosula combines the words for toucan and booby, with the latter derived from an Icelandic word meaning fool.
The only named species, R. ramirezi, honors the Peruvian paleontologist Gregorio Ramirez.
Fossils were recovered from the 4 to 5 million-year-old Sud Sacaco Level of the Pisco Formation.
The genus Ramphastosula was described by Stucchi and Urbina in 2004.
Ramphastosula belongs to the bird family Sulidae.
Fossils of Ramphastosula date to the early Pliocene epoch.
The time range for Ramphastosula is estimated between 7.246 and 5.333 million years ago.
The habitat where the fossils were found was a sheltered beach featuring rock platforms.
